provenance.decision_order: Advance timestamp, close preceding batch, apply gap rule, score preceding history, then inspect current vector. Current invalid vectors affect only subsequent decisions; unknown timestamps reset immediately.
provenance.labels_encoding: For each admitted decision: little-endian i64 decision Unix nanoseconds followed by u8 binary label.
provenance.representation: f32 natural-log features; f64 training statistics, coefficients, logits and metrics
provenance.support_encoding: For each admitted decision: little-endian u16 file ID; u64 decision raw index, common first raw index, feature first raw index, feature last raw index and common sample count; i64 decision and latest-feature Unix nanoseconds; u8 label. Each binary record is 59 bytes, with no header. Admitted segments contain consecutive unique valid raw rows.
